analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram turned negative and continues to worsen, showing a bearish convergence. The volume ratio of 0.80 to the 5-day average indicates subdued activity, lowering conviction. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is prudent.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (0.2415 → -0.6186): 음전환 후 악화 지속, 약세 수렴 진단

[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 ($77.30): SMA50($75.54) 상회 시도, 피벗 PP($77.73) 근접
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low / Lower High): 저점은 높아지나 고점 유지, 횡보 구간
[거래량·결론]
